```yaml
descriptor:
  id: weekly-group-inventory
  name: Weekly Group Inventory
  description: Loads all groups, counts by type, and summarizes the group landscape.
  version: 0.1.0
  minAppVersion: 0.1.0
  author:
    name: Community
    handle: community
  category: policies
  mode: read
skills:
  - id: load_groups
    format: graph
    label: Load Groups
    detail: Retrieve all groups with selected properties.
    settings:
      method: GET
      path: /groups
      select:
        - id
        - displayName
        - groupTypes
        - membershipRule
      scopes:
        - Group.Read.All
  - id: count_groups
    format: transform
    label: Count Groups by Type
    detail: Count groups grouped by their groupTypes.
    settings:
      kind: count-by-field
      source: "{{ load_groups.output }}"
      field: groupTypes
      buckets:
        - Security
        - Microsoft 365
        - DynamicMembership
        - DistributionList
        - SecurityAndMicrosoft365
  - id: summarize_groups
    format: llm
    label: Summarize Group Landscape
    detail: Generate a concise summary of the group counts.
    settings:
      system: You are an assistant that summarizes group data.
      prompt: "Summarize the following group counts: {{ count_groups.output }}"
      temperature: 0.7
      maxTokens: 200
definition:
  triggers:
    - id: manual
      kind: manual
    - id: weekly
      kind: scheduled
      intervalSeconds: 604800
  result:
    summary: "{{ summarize_groups.output }}"
    data: {}
```

```yaml
descriptor:
  id: top-noncompliant-models
  name: Top Noncompliant Models
  description: Lists the oldest 10 noncompliant devices and summarizes compliance.
  version: 0.1.0
  minAppVersion: 0.1.0
  author:
    name: Community
    handle: community
  category: devices
  mode: read
skills:
  - id: load_devices
    format: graph
    label: Load Managed Devices
    detail: Retrieves managed devices with compliance information.
    settings:
      method: GET
      path: /deviceManagement/managedDevices
      select:
        - id
        - deviceName
        - model
        - complianceState
        - lastSyncDateTime
      scopes:
        - DeviceManagementManagedDevices.Read.All
  - id: count_by_compliance
    format: transform
    label: Count by Compliance State
    detail: Counts devices grouped by complianceState.
    settings:
      kind: count-by-field
      source: "{{ load_devices.output }}"
      field: complianceState
      buckets:
        - compliant
        - noncompliant
        - unknown
  - id: sort_oldest_10
    format: transform
    label: Sort Oldest Devices
    detail: Sorts devices by lastSyncDateTime ascending and takes the first 10.
    settings:
      kind: sort-by
      source: "{{ load_devices.output }}"
      field: lastSyncDateTime
      direction: asc
      take: 10
  - id: summarize
    format: llm
    label: Summarize Compliance
    detail: Generates a natural language summary of the compliance data.
    settings:
      system: You are an assistant summarizing device compliance data for an admin.
      prompt: |
        Here are the oldest 10 devices:
        {{ sort_oldest_10.output }}

        Here is the count of devices by compliance state:
        {{ count_by_compliance.output }}

        Summarize the overall compliance situation in a concise paragraph.
      temperature: 0.2
      maxTokens: 150
definition:
  triggers:
    - id: manual
      kind: manual
  result:
    summary: "{{ summarize.output }}"
    data: {}
```
